description: This file defines functions for loading inclusion patterns and creating a Vitest configuration specific to the Mattermost extension. It also exports a default Vitest configuration tailored for testing the extension with certain environment variables and setup files.

methods.name: export function loadIncludePatternsFromEnv( loadIncludePatternsFromEnv
methods.description: Loads include patterns for testing from an environment variable, defaulting to process.env.

methods.name: export function createExtensionMattermostVitestConfig( createExtensionMattermostVitestConfig
methods.description: Creates a tailored Vitest configuration object for the Mattermost extension, incorporating include patterns and setup options.
